evidence_slice: Greater Cambridge Housing Trajectory and Housing Land Supply Report, April 2026, records Northstowe Phase 2 Parcel 2A with detailed planning permission S/3499/19/RM for 406 dwellings plus non-residential floorspace and open space, approved in February 2020. At March 2025, 43 dwellings were completed and 363 had not started. The report states Urban Splash is no longer delivering Parcel 2A; Homes England, as master developer, is in contractual negotiations for a new development partner and anticipates a reserved-matters application for 334 dwellings in summer 2026, construction on the remainder starting in February 2027, first remaining completions in 2027, and parcel completion in 2030. The Council treats Parcel 2A as deliverable and developable and relies on 334 additional dwellings in its trajectory.
